monthly_review.summary: You've increased intensity and efficiency this month while slightly reducing volume — a sign of focused, quality training. Pace and cadence improvements suggest better neuromuscular coordination and aerobic development.
monthly_review.highlight: Cadence increased by 21 spm — the largest absolute improvement across all metrics — indicating meaningful gains in turnover efficiency and likely reduced ground contact time.

goal_tracker.message: You need 21.6 more km across up to 9 remaining days — achievable with three 7-km Zone 2 runs (e.g., 7 km @ avg HR ≤138 bpm) or four mixed sessions totaling that distance.

insights.title: Efficiency improved despite higher HR
insights.body: Aerobic efficiency rose from 12.54 to 12.99 while average HR increased from 135 to 141 bpm — suggesting your cardiovascular system is delivering more oxygen per beat, not just working harder.

insights.title: Zone 3 dominance with underutilized Zone 1
insights.body: Zone 3 now accounts for 35% of effort (up from 36% last month — stable), but Zone 1 dropped sharply from 8% to 3%, meaning very little true recovery or foundational aerobic stimulus this month.

insights.title: Cadence-stride tradeoff emerging
insights.body: Cadence increased +21 spm while stride length decreased slightly (e.g., recent run on 2026-03-19: 67.5 cm at 145 spm vs. 77.3 cm at 145 spm on 2026-03-21), suggesting a conscious or adaptive shift toward quicker turnover — beneficial if intentional and sustainable.

insights.title: High-intensity exposure increased
insights.body: Zone 4 time rose from 11% to 12% and Zone 5 remained at 2%, but notably, your best pace improved from 475 sec/km (7:55/km) last month to 496 sec/km (8:16/km) this month — indicating intensity may be misaligned with current pacing capacity or recovery status.

recommendations.action: Do one 45-minute Zone 1 run (HR ≤125 bpm) before March 30, prioritizing relaxed breathing and cadence ≥145 spm
recommendations.reason: Zone 1 contribution dropped to just 3% this month — critical for capillary density, fat metabolism, and autonomic recovery

recommendations.action: Repeat your 2026-03-04 run (5.1 km @ 154 bpm, 8:16/km) as a controlled Zone 3 effort — aim to hold HR between 148–156 bpm and cadence ≥150 spm
recommendations.reason: This session delivered strong aerobic TE (3.3) and VO2 max stability (33.0); replicating it reinforces zone-specific neuromuscular patterning

recommendations.action: Add 3 × 30-second barefoot strides post-run on one easy day, focusing on quiet footstrike and vertical oscillation <7.5 cm
recommendations.reason: Recent vertical oscillation averages 7.3–8.3 cm; your lowest value (7.3 cm on 2026-03-19) coincided with highest ground contact (342 ms) — suggests opportunity to improve spring efficiency

weekly_focus.description: Balance the recent uptick in Zone 3/4 work with foundational aerobic stimulus and form refinement — prioritize nervous system readiness over volume.
suggested_sessions: 5 km Zone 3 tempo (HR 148–156 bpm, cadence ≥150 spm)
